description: Guatemalan worship band Miel San Marcos will hold its Miel San Marcos Conference 2026, titled "El Lugar Más Alto," at the Terrace Theater in downtown Long Beach on Friday, Nov. 6 and Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The two-day gathering brings a Spanish-language act with 3 million monthly Spotify listeners and 2.8 million YouTube subscribers into the region with the largest concentration of Guatemalan Americans in the country, drawing a national-scale audience for a full weekend rather than a single night. Miel San Marcos formed in 1998 when three brothers, Josh, Luis and Samy Morales, began leading worship at their church in San Marcos, Guatemala. Nearly every album the band has released was recorded live in front of a congregation. The group has won Dove Awards and Arpa Awards and earned a nomination at the Latin Grammy Awards. name: Chris Dave X Eric Gales X MonoNeon X Cory Henry
description: Four visionary forces in modern music collide as Chris Dave, Eric Gales, MonoNeon and Cory Henry unite for an explosive, one-of-a-kind quartet experience. Chris Dave's groundbreaking rhythms, Eric Gales' electrifying guitar work, MonoNeon's unmistakable bass grooves, and Cory Henry's extraordinary keyboard mastery come together in a fearless fusion of funk, blues, rock, jazz, and experimental sound. Each artist is a musical powerhouse in their own right, celebrated for pushing boundaries and redefining what's possible on their respective instruments. Together, they create an unpredictable sonic universe where deep grooves, raw energy, and fearless improvisation take center stage. Expect an electrifying night of extraordinary musical chemistry, spontaneous interplay, and virtuosic performances that defy genre and convention. With four master musicians sharing one stage, no two moments will ever be alike. More than a concert, this is a rare meeting of creative minds, a celebration of rhythm and raw expression, and an opportunity to witness four innovators redefining what a modern power quartet can be.
